name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Cauliflower Bake
ingredients_verbatim: 8 ounces cooked chicken breast shredded or diced (about 2 cups)
why: Cauliflower-bound chicken-cheese casserole, no starch base: 584 cal / 13g carbs / 42g protein clears the band (upper-middle cal, well under 35g carbs) on the source's own published nutrition. Oven bake, weigh-and-divide friendly, scales cleanly to 14. Every ingredient maps to the Omaha board (Chicken Breast, Butter, Cauliflower, Cream Cheese, Heavy Whipping Cream, cheddar, Ranch Seasoning Mix packet, Bacon). Not a dupe of any existing chicken bake in the catalog.
